questions.q: What are the nurain, the two lights given to the Prophet SAW?
options: Al-Fatihah and the last two verses of Al-Baqarah
questions.explain: Three gifts, including the five prayers and the last two verses of Al-Baqarah.

questions.q: What marks the relationship between a person and Allah in prayer?
options: Direct access with no intermediary, broker or appointment
questions.explain: Allah gives His servant direct access.

questions.q: How does a busy productive person differ from one who is not?
options: Busy is not the same as productive; some move left and right with no output
questions.explain: Busy is not the same as productive.

questions.q: If the father himself does not keep his prayers, commanding the family to pray is less effective.
questions.explain: True. The father is the example of prayer in the family.

questions.q: Worship only begins after retirement since a pension means stopping work.
questions.explain: False. All of life is worship, not just after retirement.

Three gifts are given to the Prophet SAW
A door of heaven opens and an angel descends
The last part of the Isra' Mi'raj begins

questions.explain: The last part began, three gifts, the door of heaven opened, then descent to Al-Aqsa and return to Makkah.

Supplication and connection with the Lord
